services.name: Catboat Tour
services.desc: Our fleet of new two-person catamaran boats are the best way to experience the splendor of Islamorada! This guided 2 hour tour will take you around some of the most pristine waters in the Florida Keys. The Boats These "Hyperglider" Catboats are stable, easy to operate, and designed for comfort. Equipped with large cushioned and shock absorbed seats, padded footwells, reboarding ladders, and bimini shades to protect from the sun, the Hyperglider is designed to deliver a comfortable experience for everyone. There is simply no other personal catamaran on the market that compares. What to Expect FUN FOR ALL AGES! • 2 Hours • 16+ to Drive

services.name: 1.5 Hour Island Jet Ski Tour
services.desc: The Ultimate Thrill Ride - our incredible island jetski tour takes you through over 26 miles of the most beautiful waters and scenery the Florida Keys has to offer. With equal parts high speed adrenaline and ecosystem discovery, our tours have something for everyone! As you captain your own jet ski, our professional and knowledgeable tour guides will share their local knowledge of Key's history and our unique ecosystems as they lead you through hidden mangrove tunnels, past pristine state parks and wildlife preserves, out to the United State's largest coral reef, and a stop at the world MOST POPULAR! • Ages 18+ to rent! • Ages 6+ to ride • Ages 14+ to operate

services.name: Jet Ski Ride Zone Rentals
services.desc: Jet Ski Rentals must stay in designated ride zone. The ride zone is a 2.5 square mile area approximately one mile from the shore. You will be escorted to and from the ride area by one of our staff members. Jet ski rentals are NOT permitted to visit the Islamorada Sandbar. Rentals have a maximum rental period of 1 hour. No extended rentals. No coming back in to change participants during rental period allowed. About Open up the throttle and hit the waves on your own personal jet ski as you explore our large ocean ride zone. Must arrive AT LEAST 30 minutes prior to reservation time to complete Ages 18+ to rent • Ages 6+ to ride • Ages 14+ to operate

services.name: Private Charters - Tropic Like It's Hot Tiki
services.desc: Private Tiki Bar Boat Charters in Islamorada! Have more than 6 people in your group? U.S. Coast Guard requirements limit most Florida Keys commercial vessels to only 6 passengers, but not us! With our USCG Certified vessel rating of 18, there’s no need to split up your group on multiple boats! About the Tiki Boat: Our brand new tiki bar boat, “Tropic Like It’s Hot”, was custom built to be the best sandbar party and sunset cruise boat in the Florida Keys. Designed for up to 18 passengers (though we think groups of 8 – 14 will be the most comfortable), Tropic Like It’s Hot offers everything you Private Tiki Cruises for up to 18 Passengers!

quotes.author: Donna Chaney
quotes.text: This was our first excursion in the Keys and my first time snorkeling. Becca and Captain Chris were great hosts and did a fantastic job of guiding us through everything and taking us to some great spots. The snorkeling was amazing - we saw tons of beautiful fish and coral. Then we spent some time hanging out at the Islamorada sandbar. I would definitely recommend this for anyone who is looking for a real Islamorada experience. And I highly recommend Captain Chris and Becca - they were very friendly and incredibly knowledgeable and went out of their way to make sure we had a great experience.

quotes.author: Mary Garrido
quotes.text: We made the decision to go to Key West but we wanted to make a stop in Islamorada to enjoy a water ride. We looked for several options and chose Spray Watersports for a YouTube video. It was an excellent experience, from beginning to end. Our schedule was at 1:30 pm, it is advisable to arrive at least 30 minutes in advance. All the staff was very kind and attentive and our guide was Sasha, who made the experience even more fun and safe because of his experience. Highly recommended for about 2 hours.

quotes.author: Patrick Donnelly
quotes.text: Had an amazing time on our snorkeling and sandbar trip! Capt. Chris and Becca were awesome — friendly, knowledgeable, and made sure everyone had a great time. The snorkeling was a highlight, we saw a ton of cool fish, plus a small shark and a stingray. Then we hit the sandbar to relax, and they had floats for us to lounge on, which was the perfect way to unwind. Highly recommend this trip if you’re looking for a fun day on the water!

quotes.author: Cliff
quotes.text: Absolutely unreal experience on the sandbar! The boat was prestige, well kept, and the crew was wonderful. The weather and visibility were perfect! Many thanks for a great run to the sandbar.
We absolutely 💯 loved the snorkeling and sandbar experience. Chris and Sophie guided and took amazing care of us. Great colorful fish 🐟 we even saw up close two Tiger Sharks 🦈 Highly recommend!
